description: This file defines the 'CreditCard' class, which is an embeddable entity representing credit card details within an order payment context. It includes fields for card type, owner, number, expiration date, and CVV, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: CreditCard
classes.description: Embeddable class representing credit card details used in payment processing.

methods.name: getCcOwner
methods.description: Returns the credit card owner's name.

methods.name: setCcOwner
methods.description: Sets the credit card owner's name.

methods.name: getCcExpires
methods.description: Returns the credit card expiration date.

methods.name: setCcExpires
methods.description: Sets the credit card expiration date.

methods.name: getCcCvv
methods.description: Returns the CVV code of the credit card.

methods.name: setCcCvv
methods.description: Sets the CVV code of the credit card.

methods.name: getCardType
methods.description: Returns the type of credit card.

methods.name: setCardType
methods.description: Sets the type of credit card.
